input: So I've been thinking about the onboarding flow and I think the biggest problem is that people don't understand what the app does until they've already dictated something. The first screen asks for microphone permission before it explains anything, and that feels pushy. I'd like to try showing a short demo video first. Then we ask for permission once they've seen the value. The other thing is the settings page, which has gotten really long. Most people never scroll past the first section, so the important options need to be at the top. We could also add a search box later if it keeps growing.
